family_semantics.quarterly_ownership: Change in explicitly reported FPI Category I and II holdings; quarterly snapshot, not a transaction date.
family_semantics.disclosed_deals: Bulk/block deal evidence. Buyer/seller identity is not automatically classified as FPI.
family_semantics.cash_market: Delivery, traded volume and price/relative-strength features; market-wide, not participant attribution.
family_semantics.stock_derivatives: Stock-specific futures/options activity; market-wide contract activity, not proof of FII positions.
family_semantics.participant_positioning: Participant-category aggregate F&O context; not participant-by-stock positioning.
family_semantics.sector_relative_strength: Stock and sector relative performance used as context, not direct FPI attribution.

correlation_controls: Each evidence family contributes at most one normalized family score per stock and horizon.
Correlated features must be combined inside their family before scoring.
Market-wide FII cash flows are context and are not treated as stock-specific transactions.
A Grade 1 result requires separately verified direct FPI transaction evidence.
missing_data_policy: Unavailable families are excluded from the score denominator and reduce coverage; not_applicable families are excluded from both score and applicable coverage denominator; neither is treated as zero.
calibration_policy: Weights and thresholds are provisional. Do not publish production rankings until historical backtests, stability checks and source-coverage validation are complete.
